_comment: Section naming for tools/asset-storybook. Every `kind` used by game-client/assets/manifest.json or catalog-manifest.json MUST appear in some section's `kinds` array — guard (H) in scripts/check_asset_manifest.mjs fails the build otherwise. This registry exists because a hand-maintained label lookup in js/sidebar.mjs silently fell through and rendered 283 dungeon assets as 'Model3d:dungeons'.
